title: The Double Standard a Godly Man Kills First
caption:
A godly man runs one court, not two.

Same law for his sin as the one he hands out to everyone else.

Notice which verdict comes faster. Give the grace you'd give him. Give the correction you give yourself. Run the same law twice, in both directions.

One law for both of you. That's the whole test.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #realtalk #humility #brotherhood
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
